title: Arcora opens in Muonio on 14 December
seoTitle: Arcora opens at Torassieppi in Muonio
description: Arcora Boutique Hotel & Villas opens at Torassieppi in Muonio on 14 December 2026, with 59 suites and villas and a rooftop infinity pool.
dek: A night starts at about 874 euros, and breakfast, winter clothing and spa access come with every stay. The first season ends on 18 April.
heroAlt: A yellow wooden church with a black spire standing in deep snow, with frost-covered birches beside it under a blue winter sky.
heroCaption: Pictured: the church in the centre of Muonio in February 2008, not Arcora, which stands at Torassieppi in the same municipality.

body.text: Arcora Boutique Hotel & Villas opens on 14 December 2026 at Torassieppi, a small place in the municipality of Muonio, north of the Arctic Circle and on the edge of Pallas-Yllästunturi National Park. Behind it is the Pietikäinen family, whose company Harriniva Hotels & Safaris has taken travellers around this part of Lapland since 1973 and is now in its third generation.

body.title: Arcora in short
items: Nearest airport: Kittilä, 60 km and 50 minutes away
JR Suite Kalle: 30 square metres, one room facing the forest, connectable to the suite next door.
Executive Suite Jussi: 43 square metres, a separate bedroom and a bathroom with a view sauna and a bathtub.
Sky Villa Antti: 37.5 square metres on two floors, with the sleeping area upstairs under a panoramic window facing north.
Deluxe Villa Jouni: 43 square metres, a standalone villa with a kitchenette, a view sauna and an outdoor hot tub.

body.text: The four categories are named after the owner brothers Kalle, Jussi, Antti and Jouni. Selected Jussi and Kalle suites interconnect into a two-bedroom suite of 73 square metres, and selected Kalle suites into a two-room suite of 60 square metres, which is worth asking about if you travel as a family.

Breakfast, winter clothing for the whole stay and daily access to the spa are included in every room rate, and the rate itself appears only once you put your dates into the booking service. According to the German magazine reisen EXCLUSIV, a night starts at about 874 euros.

On top of that come the three- and four-night Arcora Stay packages, which add all meals, selected guided experiences and return airport transfers from Kittilä or Enontekiö. Those stays are arranged with the hotel sales team by email. There is no minimum stay in the first season, not even over Christmas and New Year.
A rooftop pool and eight seasons on the plate

The spa is on the top floor of the hotel: a heated infinity pool, three saunas, an outdoor hot tub, a gym and a treatment room. In the evening the area is reserved for adults. Restaurant 8 follows the eight seasons into which the year is traditionally divided in Lapland, under chef Arto Rastas, while Kajo Bar & Artisan Bakery bakes through the day and serves an Arctic Afternoon Tea, and Pyry Champagne Bar sits a floor higher with a view over the treetops.

Seventeen guided experiences are on offer in three groups, from husky and reindeer safaris to snowshoeing in the national park, and each one can also be arranged privately. In the By Owner experiences one of the four brothers hosts the trip himself, with a guide taking care of the animals, the equipment and safety.

body.title: Distances from the airports
items: Return transfers from Kittilä or Enontekiö are included in package stays

body.text: Check-in is from 16:00 and check-out by 12:00. Children are welcome and a nanny can be arranged, pet friendly villas are available, and there is private parking on site.

Muonio has about 2,340 residents across 2,040 square kilometres, which is the quiet the resort is built on. According to the project notice published by Harriniva, the total budget for the new destination is 25 million euros, of which 1.5 million euros is EU funding, and the work runs from May 2025 to December 2026.
Villas and suites around the same national park are on our Ylläs page.
